mapper.select: SELECT m.message_id, m.message_type, m.message_level, m.title, m.content, m.source, m.create_time, m.expire_time, r.read_time FROM sys_message_recipient r INNER JOIN sys_message m ON m.message_id = r.message_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.delete_time IS NULL AND (m.expire_time IS NULL OR m.expire_time > NOW()) AND m.message_type = #{query.messageType} AND r.read_time IS NOT NULL AND r.read_time IS NULL ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.message_id DESC
